C1 | met | scripts/branch.py:204 | `adopt_tracked_state` (called at line 298) replaces the committed `items/` copy with a link to the main checkout's copy. This works when `.*` hides `.dfs`, and the newer task file reaches the worktree.
C2 | met | scripts/branch.py:229 | The same function links `order.md` (not a directory) to the main checkout's current file. The test at scripts/test_chain.py:~707 asserts the content is "current order\n".
C3 | met | scripts/branch.py:227 | `enter` calls `share_ignored_state` only when `dfs_paths.ignored()` is true (lines 371 and 391). Without an ignore rule nothing is linked, and `_would_ignore` also skips entries git does not hide.
C4 | met | scripts/branch.py:321 | `check_task_file` raises a `BranchError` naming the missing task file and the cause, called at lines 374 and 402. `branch.py enter` prints it as `dfs_branch:` and exits 2 (line 730). `run.sh:~936` then stops before any session.
C5 | met | scripts/run.sh:936 | `meta.json` is written before `enter`, and `stop_is noworktree` / `stop_is unbriefed` (line 1019) record the stop. `walk.py:102-108` and `walk.py:338-342` turn those into a reason plus the console cause, in place of "without recording why".
C6 | met | scripts/branch.py:81 | `carry_uncommitted` skips paths behind a link, so uncommitted edits to force-tracked files stay in the main checkout. The test at scripts/test_chain.py:~692 asserts that `git status` is unchanged and the edits are kept.
C7 | met | scripts/branch.py:~612 | `merge` still runs a plain `git merge --no-ff`, and `_unmerged` (line ~505) raises when the author's uncommitted edits are in the way, so git's refusal stands. This path is existing code and is pinned by scripts/test_chain.py:274. The diff does not change it, and linked files are skip-worktree so the branch never commits over them.
C8 | met | scripts/tui.py:3702 | The tree pane shows "task file missing" when `t["missing"]` is set. `tree.py:413` sets that flag in `combine`, and `status_of` and `incomplete` use it (tree.py:1220, 1267). test_review_tree.py:549 tests the pane.
C9 | met | scripts/test_chain.py:~692 | A test sets `.*` as the ignore rule, force-adds `order.md`, enters, and asserts the worktree has the links, the current `order.md` and the new `W2.md`. On the starting code the worktree would hold the old `order.md` and no `W2.md`. I did not run the suite, so "existing tests still pass" is unverified.
C10 | met | scripts/branch.py:204 | The docstrings of `adopt_tracked_state` and `share_ignored_state` (lines 204-213, 283-292) say which planning files are linked from the main checkout (ignored ones, and force-added ones in a hidden directory) and which come from the commit. The module docstring and README were not updated, and the "taken from git" side is stated only by implication.
